name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Numbered steps in an ordered list. `progress` shows where a flow stands: 22px numbered dots for done, current and upcoming steps (Import "Source · Preview · Live mock", the TestCreate and Agent flows). `list` shows numbered instructions with a mono number and 12px text (TestCreate "Before you paste", Behavior).

a11y.pattern: <ol aria-label> of <li>; the current step has aria-current="step"
aria: The list is named ("Progress") and keeps its native order and count
aria-current="step" marks the current step; done steps add a visually hidden ", done"
The number is text inside the dot; the colour of the dot is never the only cue
a11y.notes: Static item: the steps are not buttons. If users can jump to a step, put links or buttons inside the items. marker="circle" (list only) keeps the number aria-hidden: write the step number in the text (a .sr-only "Step 1: "). The aria-label is optional; leave it out only when a heading right above names the list.
